name: Anser Hard Serpulo
author: SarakaUnciv
description:
Numbered sector that does not have enemy base in vanilla this mod will make them generate base
	It is unfair and should be play with my other Anser mod or your cheat mod
	
	Make all Serpulo numbered sector enemy base
	Vanilla enemy base sector have Extreme threat while other sector have Eradication threat
	Vanilla enemy base sector map does not effect by threat level meaning they still have the same building (and wave?) as in vanilla
	Numbered sector that does not have enemy base in vanilla this mod will make them generate base
	Eradication difficulty give x16 hp and x0.04 wave timer
	
	It took me 3 attempt to beat Nuclear Production Complex with my OP mod
	And then lost NPC after enemy send attack 1 time
	
	This mod was made in build 160.4
	If you want to make every sector to be Eradication threat instead of Extreme
	You can change my script change threat from 0.75 to 1.0 or higher
